id: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith (2005)
title: Star Wars: Episode III, Revenge of the Sith
about: As the Clone Wars end, Anakin is pulled to the dark side and the Jedi fall.
cue: Serve dessert when Anakin and Obi-Wan rescue the Chancellor.
faces: AN EVENING OF THE FINEST KIND
“I've cooked for you since you were a boy, Anakin. Sit down and eat something before the council meets.”
Butter-fried mushrooms with garlic and thyme on toast, shaved parmesan.
Chicken, leek and tarragon in cream, baked in puff pastry cases.
Five spice roast duck brushed with an orange, honey and soy glaze.
Senate chamber beef fillet, red wine jus
The halls of power on Coruscant.
Molten dark chocolate cakes with a berry coulis.
Orange and pineapple juice over ice with grenadine sunk to the bottom, no alcohol.

Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine. No discussing Palpatine and the Plagueis tale at the tables. Card No. 66. Showtime: Serve dessert when Anakin and Obi-Wan rescue the Chancellor.

    StartersKashyyyk garlic mushrooms on sourdoughButter-fried mushrooms with garlic and thyme on toast, shaved parmesanHow to make it500g mixed mushrooms, sliced50g butter2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp thyme leaves4 thick slices of sourdough50g parmesan, shavedFry the mushrooms in the butter over high heat until golden. Add the garlic and thyme and cook another minute.Toast the sourdough, pile the mushrooms on top and finish with parmesan and a crack of pepper.Utapau creamy chicken vol-au-ventsChicken, leek and tarragon in cream, baked in puff pastry casesHow to make it16 vol-au-vent cases1 leek, sliced30g butter300g chicken breast, finely diced150ml thickened cream1 tbsp chopped tarragonSoften the leek in the butter, add the chicken and cook through.Stir in the cream and tarragon and simmer until thick.Spoon into the cases and bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until golden and hot.MainsCoruscant opera house roast duckFive spice roast duck brushed with an orange, honey and soy glazeHow to make it2kg whole duck1 tbsp salt1 tsp five spice2 oranges, juiced3 tbsp honey2 tbsp soy sauce2 star anises300g jasmine ricePrick the duck all over and rub with salt and five spice. Set on a rack in a tray.Roast at 180°C for 1 hour 30 minutes.Meanwhile simmer the orange juice, honey, soy and star anise until syrupy.Brush the glaze over the duck and roast another 15 minutes. Steam the rice.Rest the duck for 10 minutes, carve and serve over rice with the rest of the glaze.Senate chamber beef fillet, red wine jusThe halls of power on CoruscantHow to make itAs written, serves 4Eye fillet roasted to medium rare and sliced, with a glossy red wine jus, a crunchy-topped potato gratin and honey roasted carrots.Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180°C for 1 hour, adding 40g grated parmesan for the last 15 minutes.Roast 500g carrots with oil and honey.Sear a 1kg eye fillet on all sides, then roast at 220°C to 54°C inside, about 20 minutes, and rest.Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml beef stock and thyme to a glossy jus and whisk in 20g butter.SweetsMustafar lava cakesMolten dark chocolate cakes with a berry coulisHow to make it150g dark chocolate150g butter3 eggs, plus 3 yolks80g caster sugar50g plain flour250g raspberriesMelt the chocolate and butter. Whisk the eggs, yolks and sugar until thick, then fold in the chocolate and flour.Pour into greased moulds and bake at 200°C for 10 minutes.Blend the raspberries and strain into a coulis. Turn out the cakes and pour the coulis over.DrinksTwin sunset cocktailOrange and pineapple juice over ice with grenadine sunk to the bottom, no alcoholHow to make it500ml orange juice500ml pineapple juice4 tbsp grenadine1 bag iceFill four tall glasses with ice. Pour in equal parts of the orange and pineapple juice, leaving room at the top.Slowly pour a splash of grenadine down the side so it sinks and glows red and orange like a double sunset.
